COMMAND.name: no
COMMAND.help: Negate a command or set its defaults

COMMAND.name: port
COMMAND.ACTION: Cur_set=$(egrep -v "^#" /etc/ssh/sshd_config |grep ^Port |awk '{print $2}') if [ "$Cur_set" = "${Port}" ]; then exit 0 fi ${RT_SBIN}/titian-sys.sh port-in-use "${Port}" if grep -q '^Port' /etc/ssh/sshd_config; then ${RT_SBIN}/titian-sys.sh sed-replace /etc/ssh/sshd_config "s|^Port.*|Port ${Port}|" else echo "Port ${Port}" >> /etc/ssh/sshd_config fi ${RT_SBIN}/titian-sys.sh ssh-restart

COMMAND.name: allow-root
COMMAND.ACTION: Cur_set=$(egrep -v "^#" /etc/ssh/sshd_config |grep PermitRootLogin |awk '{print $2}') if [ "$Cur_set" = "yes" ]; then exit 0 fi if grep -q '^PermitRootLogin' /etc/ssh/sshd_config; then ${RT_SBIN}/titian-sys.sh sed-replace /etc/ssh/sshd_config "s|^PermitRootLogin.*|PermitRootLogin yes|" else echo "PermitRootLogin yes" >> /etc/ssh/sshd_config fi ${RT_SBIN}/titian-sys.sh ssh-restart

COMMAND.name: no allow-root
COMMAND.ACTION: Cur_set=$(egrep -v "^#" /etc/ssh/sshd_config |grep PermitRootLogin |awk '{print $2}') if [ "$Cur_set" = "no" ]; then exit 0 fi if grep -q '^PermitRootLogin' /etc/ssh/sshd_config; then ${RT_SBIN}/titian-sys.sh sed-replace /etc/ssh/sshd_config "s|^PermitRootLogin.*|PermitRootLogin no|" else echo "PermitRootLogin no" >> /etc/ssh/sshd_config fi ${RT_SBIN}/titian-sys.sh ssh-restart

COMMAND.name: disable-host-validation
COMMAND.help: Don't validate the remote host name with DNS
COMMAND.ACTION: Cur_stat=$(egrep -v "^#" /etc/ssh/sshd_config |egrep "^UseDNS" |awk '{print $2}') if [ -z "$Cur_stat" ]; then echo "UseDNS no" >> /etc/ssh/sshd_config ${RT_SBIN}/titian-sys.sh ssh-restart elif [ "$Cur_stat" = "no" ]; then exit 0 else ${RT_SBIN}/titian-sys.sh sed-replace /etc/ssh/sshd_config "s|^UseDNS.*|UseDNS no|" ${RT_SBIN}/titian-sys.sh ssh-restart fi

COMMAND.name: no disable-host-validation
COMMAND.help: Validate the remote host name with DNS
COMMAND.ACTION: Cur_stat=$(egrep -v "^#" /etc/ssh/sshd_config |egrep "^UseDNS" |awk '{print $2}') if [ -z "$Cur_stat" ]; then echo "UseDNS yes" >> /etc/ssh/sshd_config ${RT_SBIN}/titian-sys.sh ssh-restart elif [ "$Cur_stat" = "yes" ]; then exit 0 else ${RT_SBIN}/titian-sys.sh sed-replace /etc/ssh/sshd_config "s|^UseDNS.*|UseDNS yes|" ${RT_SBIN}/titian-sys.sh ssh-restart fi
